buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Provisions for workmen compensation, insurance, public liability, property damage, insurance etc. to be ensured by the contractor. Also, safety measures prescribed for working in Extra High Voltage & use of personnel protective equipment must be adhered to. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

The bidder must provide a declaration on an INR 100 of non-judicial stamp paper issued after the start of t he bid date and duly notarized, confirming they have not been de barred or blacklisted by any bid-inviting authority, or by any Central or State govt. organizations, semi-govt. bodies, PSUs, Defence, or paramilitary forces. 2. The bidder is required to furnish an affidavit on INR 100 stamp paper issued after the start of the bid d ate and duly notarized, affirming that the information provided in the bid is accurate. The bidder will bear s ole responsibility for any false information. Failure to submit this affidavit will lead to bid rejection. 3. The bidder should have an office in Delhi for better service support and the bidder applying for this bi d should have the capability to carry out complete supply and installation as per the contract. 4. Bidders should have valid GST & MSME Certificate within the consignee state and the same should be uploaded along with the bid. 5. The bidder must submit a copy of their GST registrations and the GSTR3B filed documents for the lates t six months. 6. The bidder must submit a positive net worth and turnover certificate for the last three financial years, certified by a Chartered Accountant 7. Years of Past Experience required: The bidder should have experience for minimum 03 years (ending month of March prior to the bid opening) of supplying similar type of products to any Central / State Govt. Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company. Copies of relevant contracts orders to be uploaded along with bid in support of having supplied products during each of the Financial Year. 8. Bidder must possess valid ISO 9001:2015 issued prior to the date of bid, Copies of these certificates m ust be uploaded in the bid. 9. Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar pro ceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload the undertaking to this effect with bid. 10. The bidder should quote the price inclusive of all Supply/Charges / Taxes / Installation & FOR destinat ion by referring the uploaded Specification document. 11. The bidder must provide a declaration on an INR 100 of non-judicial stamp paper duly notarized the t ender acceptance Letter mentioning the unconditional acceptance of all additional terms & conditions and Product Specification of the tender document on company’s letter head duly signed & stamped by the auth orized signatory. 12. The bidder will have to provide separate stamp notarized certificate refer to ATC Point No.1,2 and 11 13. The Bidder should be a business entity and registered for the supply of IT/Information technology pro ducts business in India for the last 5 years. 14. The bidder shall clearly satisfy all warranty conditions, and the proposed items must confirm to the r equired technical specifications and maintain a minimum gem rating of four stars, same will be verified thr ough online GeM Portal at the time of opening of bid. 15. The OEM mandate to provide bid-specific Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) on their letterhead. This must include the bid number and be signed by an authorized representative, to avoid fake submissio n of OEM Authorization form, it will be verified with the OEM by the department at any stage before awardi ng the work order 16. The OEM must submit the Local content declaration for the product and configuration offered on thei r letter head. 17. OEM must have online system hardware diagnostics facility or BIOS based hardware diagnostics faci lity. OEM must have the facility to download the updates of preinstalled Software, device drivers and firm ware from its website. 18. OEM must support recovery media creation through its website to re install the operating system wh en required and bring the computer back to its original factory condition as configured by the OEM. 19. OEM must submit Valid ISO 9001,14001,20001, 27001, MIL STD 810 H, RoHS, Energy star 8, EPEAT GOLD, EPR, UL, CE, FCC, Product carbon footprint & TCO certificate for display. 20. OEM must submit confirmation documents for preloaded Windows operating system.

21. OEM must confirm there should be digital product key for Windows11 professional embedded in the mother board and OS should be OEM factory pre-loaded. 22. Graphics type should be integrated in all product (AIO Desktop/Desktop/Laptop). 23. Original Microsoft Office (should have at least Word, Excel, Powerpoint) be installed in every Computer . 24. In MFM Printer duty cycle should be 5000 per Month. 25. All Products should be supplied with 3 years on site OEM warranty. . 4.
